chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Fadhl narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Durays ibn Abd al-Malik, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): 'A man permits the private part of his slave girl to his brother.' He said: 'It is permissible for him.' I said: 'What if she bears a child from him?' He said: 'The child belongs to the master of the slave girl, unless he stipulated to the master of the slave girl when he permitted her to him: 'If she bears a child, he is free.'
ai.seo_question: Who owns the child if a master permits another man to have relations with his slave girl?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the fiqh of *tamlik al-suh* (granting sexual access) where a master permits another man to have intercourse with his slave girl. It establishes that the resulting child belongs to the original master by default, unless a specific condition (*shart*) was stipulated at the time of granting permission that the child would be freed or belong to the father. This ruling highlights the importance of contractual stipulations in pre-modern Shia jurisprudence regarding the status of offspring in concubinage.
